title: Write English content: home page + 4 core MS pages
description: Write English translations for the home page and the four most essential content pages: What is MS (kakvo-e-ms), Types of MS (vidove-ms), What is a Relapse (pristap), and Symptoms (simptomi). These are the highest-traffic pages and should be done first.

title: Implement browser language auto-detection
description: On first visit (no localStorage preference set), detect navigator.language client-side. If the language is not Bulgarian (bg), automatically redirect to the /en/ version of the current page. Store the detected preference in localStorage so the redirect only happens once.

title: Build LanguageSwitcher component
description: Create a BG/EN toggle UI component that appears in the site header on all pages. Clicking switches the language by navigating to the corresponding page in the other language. Saves user preference to localStorage so the choice persists across visits.

title: Configure Astro i18n routing and content structure
description: Set up the technical foundation for bilingual support. Configure Astro 5 i18n in astro.config.mjs, restructure content collections to support bg/en languages, and set up /en/ route prefix for English pages. Bulgarian stays at current URLs, English lives under /en/. This is a prerequisite for all other i18n tasks.

title: Phase 2: add WebPage JSON-LD to section pages
description: Add a plain WebPage JSON-LD block in SectionLayout.astro so every section page has structured metadata. Use name, description, and url properties only. Do NOT use MedicalWebPage schema — that implies clinical authority this site intentionally does not claim. Patient-perspective informational content is best represented honestly as WebPage.

title: Phase 2: add FAQPage JSON-LD to /chesti-vaprosi
description: The chesti-vaprosi page is a natural FAQPage. Add JSON-LD structured data that maps each question/answer pair so Google can render accordion rich results in search. This requires reading the content and structuring it as mainEntity Q&A pairs. High impact, no authority claim needed — it is pure content structure.

title: Phase 2: add WebSite JSON-LD to home page
description: Add a WebSite schema block to the index.astro page. This establishes ms-navigator.eu as a named entity in Google's knowledge graph. No authority claims needed — just name, url, and description. Enables sitelinks search box eligibility as the site grows.

title: Phase 1: add sitemap.xml and robots.txt
description: Install @astrojs/sitemap and register it in astro.config.mjs so a sitemap-index.xml is generated at build time. Add public/robots.txt pointing crawlers to the sitemap. Without these, Google must discover all 11 section pages through link-crawling alone.

title: Phase 1: add canonical URL and og:url to BaseLayout
description: Add <link rel='canonical'> and og:url meta tag to BaseLayout.astro using Astro.url so every page self-references its canonical form. Prevents ranking signal dilution if the site is ever accessible on www or HTTP variants. Also add og:image with a placeholder or a real social-share image.

title: SEO: improve search engine reachability
description: The site ms-navigator.eu has good bones (static HTML, semantic markup, per-page titles/descriptions) but is missing several standard SEO signals. This epic tracks three phases of work to improve discoverability on Google and other Bulgarian-language search engines. Phases are ordered by effort/impact ratio.

title: Set up Cloudflare redirect: ms-navigator.eu → ms-navigator.bg
description: Register ms-navigator.eu on Cloudflare (free plan). Point ms-navigator.eu nameservers to Cloudflare. Create a single Redirect Rule: ms-navigator.eu/* → https://ms-navigator.bg/$1 (301 permanent). See docs/guides/cloudflare-eu-redirect.md for full step-by-step guide.
close_reason: ms-navigator.bg is now the primary domain serving GitHub Pages; ms-navigator.eu redirects via Cloudflare 301

title: Switch primary domain to ms-navigator.bg
description: Update astro.config.mjs site to 'https://ms-navigator.bg' and public/CNAME to 'ms-navigator.bg'. Update GitHub Pages custom domain setting to ms-navigator.bg. Add DNS A records for ms-navigator.bg pointing to GitHub Pages IPs (185.199.108-111.153). See docs/guides/cloudflare-eu-redirect.md for full guide.
close_reason: ms-navigator.bg is now the primary domain serving GitHub Pages; ms-navigator.eu redirects via Cloudflare 301

title: Connect to GitHub and push
description: Add remote origin github.com/coldsoul/ms-navigator, push main, verify Actions workflow runs and site deploys. Configure custom domain ms-navigator.bg in GitHub Pages settings and add DNS A records. See plan Task 13.

title: GitHub Actions deployment workflow
description: Create .github/workflows/deploy.yml: build+type-check on PRs, build+deploy to GitHub Pages on main. Uses actions/checkout@v4, setup-node@v4, upload-pages-artifact@v3, deploy-pages@v4. See plan Task 12.

title: Public assets — CNAME and favicon
description: Create public/CNAME containing 'ms-navigator.bg' and public/favicon.svg (teal circle). Add favicon link to BaseLayout. See plan Task 11.

title: Eleven section pages
description: Create src/pages/*.astro for all 11 sections (kakvo-e-ms, vidove-ms, pristap, simptomi, izsledvania, lechenie, meditsinski-ekip, hranene-i-dieti, sharlatani, emotsii, chesti-vaprosi). Each uses getEntry from content collection. Verify all 11 routes exist in dist/ after build. See plan Task 10.

title: Content Collection — schema and 11 Markdown placeholders
description: Create src/content/config.ts (sections collection, schema: title+summary). Create src/content/sections/*.md for all 11 sections with placeholder headings and frontmatter. See plan Task 9.

title: SectionLayout component
description: Create src/components/SectionLayout.astro: BackButton + h1 + summary + prose slot + Disclaimer at bottom. Uses @tailwindcss/typography for markdown rendering. See plan Task 7.

title: Home page — index.astro
description: Final home page: header with dot logo, h1 hero, Disclaimer, 2-column card grid with all 11 SectionCards, footer. Compare visually with documents/ms-navigator-homepage.html. See plan Task 8.

title: Disclaimer and BackButton components
description: Create src/components/Disclaimer.astro (amber warning box) and BackButton.astro (← link with 48px tap target). See plan Task 5.

title: SectionCard component
description: Create src/components/SectionCard.astro with icon/title/description/arrow, hover lift+border+shadow, focus-visible ring, staggered animation via animationDelay prop. See plan Task 6.

title: BaseLayout.astro
description: Create HTML shell with meta/OG tags, Google Fonts, skip-to-content link, analytics comment slot. Verify dev server renders warm background and fonts. See plan Task 4.

title: Install Astro and Tailwind
description: npm install astro @astrojs/tailwind tailwindcss @tailwindcss/typography, create astro.config.mjs and src/env.d.ts. See plan Task 2.

title: Tailwind design tokens
description: Write full theme in tailwind.config.mjs: colors, fonts, custom breakpoint, fade-in-up animation. See plan Task 3.

title: Repo foundation — git, .gitignore, npm, beads
description: Initialize git repo, create .gitignore and package.json, run bd init. See plan Task 1 in docs/superpowers/plans/2026-04-25-ms-navigator.md

title: Update sitemap to include both language URLs
description: Ensure the Astro sitemap integration generates entries for both /en/ and default BG URLs. May require configuring the sitemap plugin or adding custom sitemap logic.

title: Add hreflang and lang attributes for bilingual SEO
description: Update BaseLayout.astro to dynamically set the correct lang attribute on <html>, add hreflang alternate link tags pointing to both language versions of each page, and update og:locale meta tag per language. This ensures Google understands the language relationship between pages.

title: Write English content: treatment and medical pages
description: Write English translations for 3 pages: Tests and Investigations (izsledvania), Treatment (lechenie), Your Medical Team (meditsinski-ekip).

title: Write English content: lifestyle, wellbeing and about pages
description: Write English translations for 4 remaining pages: Diet and Nutrition (hranene-i-dieti), Watch Out: Scams (sharlatani), The Emotional Side (emotsii), FAQ (chesti-vaprosi), and About the Site (za-sayta).

title: Phase 3: create About page
description: Create a short /about page explaining who built this site and why — a person living with MS, writing in Bulgarian for other Bulgarians with MS. This is the site's strongest trust signal (Google E-E-A-T: lived Experience). The page should be honest, personal, and brief. Add it to the home page nav/footer.

title: Phase 3: add privacy-respecting analytics
description: Add Plausible or a similar privacy-first analytics tool. The Analytics placeholder comment already exists in BaseLayout.astro. Without data, there is no way to know which pages get traffic or what search terms bring visitors. GDPR-compliant option preferred given the Bulgarian/EU audience.
close_reason: Plausible script added directly to BaseLayout.astro

title: Phase 3: submit sitemap to Google Search Console and verify site
description: After Phase 1 is deployed, verify ownership of ms-navigator.eu in Google Search Console and submit the sitemap URL. Monitor for crawl errors and initial indexing. This is a manual step requiring access to the domain DNS or site files for verification. Prerequisite: Phase 1 must be live.
notes: Defer until ms-navigator.bg domain and Cloudflare redirect are live. Verify both domains in GSC, submit sitemap on .bg only. See conversation for full walkthrough.

title: Phase 3: add internal cross-links between related sections
description: The 11 section pages currently exist in isolation. Adding contextual links between related pages (e.g. simptomi → izsledvania, lechenie → meditsinski-ekip) distributes PageRank internally and helps crawlers understand content relationships. Edit the .md source files to add natural in-text links rather than a mechanical sidebar.
